# Linda's Nails

> Nails & spa based in Georgetown, Texas. A friendly nail and spa on N Austin Ave where moms and daughters come in together. Relaxing spa pedicures, clean manicures, gel and acrylic sets, and patient techs who help you pick the color.

- Phone: (512) 240-5924
- Based in: Georgetown, TX
- Nearby areas: Georgetown, Round Rock, Leander, Liberty Hill, Jarrell, Hutto
- Google rating: 4.5 from 366 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/lindas-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/lindas-nails/book.html

## Services
- Spa pedicures: Five pedicures, from the classic Tropical to the Milk & Honey with paraffin and a hot stone massage.
- Manicures: Trim, shape, cuticle care and polish of your choice, finished with a lotion massage and hot towels.
- Gel manicures: Gel polish that lasts longer, with a glossy shine and zero dry time.
- Acrylic sets: Long coffin, square, almond and stiletto sets, shaped and finished the way you like them.
- Nail art: Drips, florals, animal print, hearts, swirls and line art, painted by hand.
- Holiday sets: Spiders for Halloween, warm fall colors, snowmen and candy-cane stripes for Christmas, and whatever the season calls for next.

## About
Linda's Nails & Spa sits at 600 N Austin Ave in Georgetown. It's the kind of salon where moms bring their daughters, sisters come in together, and a lot of clients say they've been coming for years and won't go anywhere else. Clients mention the techs by name (Chloe, Dee and Jenny come up again and again) and say they're patient while you decide on a service and pick out a color, even if you're the indecisive type. Bring a picture and they'll match it. The menu runs from a quick Basic Manicure to the Milk & Honey Pedicure with paraffin and a hot stone massage, plus gel, acrylic sets and hand-painted nail art. Walk-ins are welcome, there's a complimentary drink while you sit back, and 366 Google reviews later it's still a relaxing place to spend an hour.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome Monday to Saturday. If you want a set time, especially on a Saturday, call (512) 240-5924 first.
- Q: Can my mom and I come in together?
  A: Yes, lots of our regulars do. Call (512) 240-5924 and we'll find a time for both of you.
- Q: What's the difference between the pedicures?
  A: Tropical ($32) is the classic. Signature ($40) adds a 4-step spa with sugar scrub and masque. CBL ($49) adds argan oil and paraffin wax. Jelly ($65) and Milk & Honey ($75) add a deep tissue hot stone massage.
- Q: How much is gel?
  A: A Gel Manicure is $37. You can add gel polish to any pedicure for $17.
- Q: Can I bring a picture of the nails I want?
  A: Please do. Show us the photo and we'll match the shape, length and design.
- Q: Do you do waxing or eyelash extensions?
  A: Yes, both are on our service list. Call (512) 240-5924 for times and prices.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9:30 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9:30 AM to 6 PM, closed Sunday. Holiday hours can differ.
- Q: Where are you, and where do I park?
  A: 600 N Austin Ave, Suite F, Georgetown, TX 78626. There's a private parking lot, and we take cards and Apple Pay.
